scope: Source-derived family reconciliation. Discovery records are candidates, not features. Family ownership does not certify every nested control or visual state.

families.authority: Renderer route state; palette invokes existing feature actions rather than a universal backend endpoint. Contributions add run callbacks.
families.android: HermesApp.kt and SettingsScreen.kt: native destination routing, no universal command palette. Settings has Appearance, Gateways, System, Plugins, Notifications; contributed feature launchers are distinct. Missing destinations are not implicitly non-goals.
families.review_limit: Source reconciliation only; rendered and independent review remain owed.
